newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates steady to lower on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates steady to lower on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were offered steady to lower in thin Wednesday dealings on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Tuesday. Bids and offers included:
- Two barges, next week, lower Ohio river, no bid, offered 190 percent, unchanged.
- Four barges, week of September 29, Mid-Mississippi, no bid, offered 220 percent.
- Four barges, one each week of October, Illinois river, bid 230 percent of tariff, unchanged, offered 245 percent, down five percentage points.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), no bid, offered 220 percent.
- Eight barges, two each week of October, Mid-Mississippi, bid 240 percent, offered 250 percent.
- Four barges, one each week of NOvember, Illinois river, bid 205 percent (two each week), offered 212-1/2 percent.
